Aisha: Quick sync — AWS marketplace SI partner wants a 12mo committed spend offer that layers a hardware credit from our HW partner. They want clear renewal triggers and a simple co-sell announcement cadence. Can we align on discount stacking?
Liam: Sounds common. Key Q: do we allow stackable discounts (marketplace + private offer) or enforce max effective discount?
Sofia: From product POV we need to protect unit economics. Recommend max combined discount = 30% unless exec signoff. Also want to avoid multi-tier SKU drift at renewal.
Raj: For SI invoicing, they prefer a single purchase order that splits to us + HW partner. Need to confirm if we support split billing or if partner invoices hardware separately.
Marcel: Legal note — if HW credit is conditional on committed usage, we must specify clawback language for under-delivery and clear renewal credit carryover rules. I can draft template wording.
Aisha: Good. Proposal draft: 12mo commit tiers: 
```
Tier A: $250k+ commit -> 18% Marketplace discount + $40k HW credit
Tier B: $500k+ commit -> 22% Marketplace discount + $100k HW credit
Tier C: $1M+ commit -> 28% Marketplace discount + $250k HW credit
```
We cap total effective discount at 30% except C-level approval.
Liam: I like tiers but suggest a faster acceleration for renewal incentives: if they renew early (>=90 days before term end) give +2% additive discount on the next term and carry-forward 25% of unused HW credit.
Sofia: Early-renew bonus is fine but must be modeled: does it stack with committed acceleration promos? If yes, need a clear precedence table.
Marcel: Agree. I'll add precedence + example scenarios in the template. Also add explicit definitions: "unused HW credit" = credited but not invoiced within term; carry-forward limited to 12 months.
Raj: Operational ask: SI needs an on-boarding checklist for usage reporting cadence so we can validate committed consumption monthly. I'll draft a CSV schema they can upload to our partner portal.
Aisha: Awesome. Next steps: Marcel to drop draft contract clauses by EOD Friday, Raj to share reporting schema Monday, Sofia to run an impact calc on rev/net unit economics by next Tue. Liam to own partner negotiation cadence + draft announcement plan with PR team. I'll coordinate an internal review Thurs AM. :thumbsup:
announce-bot: Created task card: Partnerships-1945678901 - "Marketplace+HW commit offer — draft & ops" assigned to Marcel, Raj, Sofia, Liam, due 2026-03-26
Liam: One more — for the announcement cadence: proposed joint customer case study 90 days post-go-live, co-branded press release at launch, and partner exec webinar at 30 days. Thoughts?
Sofia: That timeline works. Ensure we have usage privacy/consent covered before customer case study.
Marcel: I'll add a customer opt-in checklist to the contract appendix.
Aisha: Great. I'll run this in the Friday partnership sync and surface any escalations. Thanks all!
